meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

copy.tagline: 把首个智能体接入私信频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚布置好智能体服务,想快速接通私信频道。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and send a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up an agent service and want to quickly wire it to a DM channel.

howto.what: 引导你把第一个 NanoClaw agent 接到某个私信频道：解析你的频道身份、新建或复用 agent，并让它通过正常投递路径给你发一条欢迎私信。所有步骤是幂等的，重复运行安全。
howto.when: 在频道凭据已配置、服务正在运行之后使用：当你要为某个私信频道建第一个 agent 时，它会接管这段流程。若服务未启动，它会先让你运行 /setup。

say.text: 帮我初始化第一个 agent，让它在我的私信频道给我发欢迎消息
say.note: 会先问你频道、你的用户 id 和显示名

say.text: 用 Telegram 建第一个 agent，走配对码，不先私信机器人
say.note: 生成配对码，你在 Telegram 里发回来

say.text: 欢迎私信没收到，帮我查 outbound.db 和日志
say.note: 检查是否卡在 pending 或容器崩溃

howto.what_en: Walks you through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel: resolve your channel identity, create or reuse the agent, and have it send a welcome DM through the normal delivery path. Steps are idempotent, so reruns are safe.
howto.when_en: Use it after channel credentials are configured and the service is running. It takes over when you want the first agent created for a DM channel; if the service is stopped, it tells you to run /setup first.

say_en.text: Set up my first agent and have it DM me a welcome message
say_en.note: It first asks for your channel and user id

say_en.text: Create my first Telegram agent using the pair code, no DM first
say_en.note: You get a code to send back in Telegram

say_en.text: The welcome DM didn't arrive — check outbound.db and the logs
say_en.note: Looks for stuck pending rows or crashes
